speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you describe the tremors in your hands and when you first noticed them? Also, can you give me more details about the memory issues you've been experiencing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I first noticed a tremor in my left hand about a year ago, and it has been getting worse since then. speaker: Doctor
text: The tremor appears to be unilateral and progressive, which is a classic sign of Parkinson's disease, often accompanied by cognitive changes. DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease
